title: JACKETEK Development Size Chart
status: APPROVED FOR DEVELOPMENT USE — NOT PRODUCTION APPROVED

developmentUse.scope: Development tech packs, pattern making and the physical M sample.

production.requires: Pattern maker + physical M sample measured, then explicit JACKETEK production approval in a revised Master Spec.

rounding: Every value is computed unrounded per size from Golden Bear's published rows and rounded to 0.1 cm only for output.

classes.DEVELOPMENT_TARGET: JACKETEK development target or development rule (approved for development use).
classes.DERIVED: Calculated per size from targets, Golden Bear or a stated rule by the formula shown.
classes.PATTERN_MAKER_SET: Set by the pattern maker; no defensible number from the sources.
classes.SAMPLE_VALIDATION: Known / confirmed only on the physical M sample. Every value in this chart is validated there.

sourceHierarchy.use: Body volume, length and shoulder benchmark; the size-to-size grading of every graded dimension. Set-in shoulder: never transferred directly to the dropped shoulder.
M silhouette check (half chest 61, length 68, shoulder 50). Unverified, methods unknown; its grading is not recorded and is not used; its 51 cm sleeve is not used.
POM structure, measuring locations, method diagrams, and the visual proportion of the dropped shoulder. No physical value; no cm from drawing units.
Confirms or corrects every value here before anything is production approved.

shoulderExtension.name: Dropped-shoulder extension per side
shoulderExtension.status: JACKETEK DEVELOPMENT RULE (approved for development use 2026-10-11) — validated by the pattern maker and the M sample; NOT production approved
shoulderExtension.rule: JACKETEK across shoulder (size) = Golden Bear set-in across shoulder (size) + 2 × 5.0 cm. Constant extension for every size unless a pattern constraint requires otherwise.
shoulderExtension.replaces: REJECTED / REPLACED — not an active rule: the earlier proposal of 3.0 cm per side (B09 / B01 ≈ 0.895) was rejected by JACKETEK on 2026-10-11 because it under-represents the dropped-shoulder proportion of the canonical S.i.-based JACKETEK flat.
why: Golden Bear supplies the set-in shoulder width and its grading; the dropped shoulder moves the shoulder point outwards by the extension on each side.
JACKETEK's visual reading of the canonical S.i.-based flat: shoulder-point width ≈ 0.96 × half-chest width for the M silhouette → 0.96 × 62.0 = 59.5 cm, which matches 49.53 + 2 × 5.0 = 59.53 cm.

The S.i. flat is a proportional / visual reference only: no drawing unit is converted to cm. (Recorded for transparency: a landmark measurement on the stylised drawing gives shoulder-point span ÷ chest width ≈ 1.20; the drawing is not to scale and neither ratio is a measurement.)
The pattern maker and the M sample validate the rule; a pattern constraint may require a different extension, proposed explicitly.

core.name: Half Chest — Flat Width (2.54 cm below the armhole point)
core.formula: M 62.0 + n × 3.81 (Golden Bear half-chest step), rounded to 0.1
core.method: Garment flat, snaps closed, straight side seam to side seam 2.54 cm below the armhole point. Flat width only; the circumference (B01-C) is derived, never measured separately.

userChart.note: half / flat chest; height below armhole not known

sources.si: CHEST POM location (front, below armhole); no value used

core.choice: Approved 62.0 cm: the practical value nearest Golden Bear's verified 62.23 cm, 1.0 cm above the supplied chart's 61.

core.name: Centre-Back Length — collar seam → finished waistband edge
core.formula: M 68.0 + n × 1.27 (Golden Bear step), rounded to 0.1
core.method: Garment flat, back up, rib relaxed. Centre back at the collar seam → finished bottom edge of the waistband rib, straight along CB.

sources.si: BACK LENGTH POM location; no value used

core.choice: Approved 68.0 cm = the supplied M silhouette value, 0.7 cm longer than Golden Bear (start points of both unknown).

derived.name: Across Shoulder — dropped shoulder, seam point to seam point (straight, back up)
derived.label: DERIVED DEVELOPMENT VALUE
derived.formula: Golden Bear across shoulder (size) + 2 × SC-1 = Golden Bear (size) + 10.0

goldenBear.note: 19½" set-in — fit and grading reference, not transferred directly

userChart.note: construction and method unknown — visual reference only

sources.si: ACROSS SHOULDER POM (dropped shoulder as drawn); proportional / visual justification of the drop only

roles: Golden Bear supplies the grading behaviour (¾" = 1.905 cm per size)
+10.0 cm total extension = JACKETEK's dropped-shoulder development rule (SC-1 = 5.0 cm per side)
The S.i. flat gives the visual / proportional justification
The M sample and the pattern maker validate the rule

derived.name: Sleeve — shoulder point → finished cuff edge (SECONDARY)
derived.label: DERIVED DEVELOPMENT VALUE
derived.formula: Golden Bear sleeve from centre back (size) − ½ × JACKETEK B09 (size)
assumptions: The centre-back sleeve reaches the same wrist on the set-in reference and the dropped JACKETEK jacket; only the split between shoulder and sleeve changes.

Centre back → shoulder point ≈ ½ × across shoulder (CB-sleeve convention). The real path (neck curve, shoulder slope) is slightly longer, so the sleeve may come out up to ~1–2 cm long — checked on the sample.
Golden Bear's sleeve end point is not stated; assumed the finished cuff edge, hence S02-E (edge), not S02 (seam).

goldenBear.note: 35½" from centre back, set-in — REFERENCE ONLY

userChart.note: 51 cm sleeve not used: method unverified

sources.si: Sleeve POM location; no value used

derived.name: Sleeve — shoulder point → cuff seam (PRIMARY JACKETEK sleeve)
derived.label: FORMULA ONLY until S09 is set
derived.formula: S02 = S02-E − S09 (S09 = cuff rib height, PATTERN_MAKER_SET)
derived.worked: S02-E − S09 (no number until S09 is set)
derived.missing: S09 cuff rib height — PATTERN_MAKER_SET (depends on the rib the factory proposes).

sources.si: Sleeve / cuff POM locations; S.i. rib height is an example value — not used

derived.name: Chest circumference — derived only, never measured separately
derived.label: DERIVED (B01 × 2)

derived.name: Sleeve from centre back → finished cuff edge — REFERENCE / COMPARISON ONLY (S01-E; S01 → cuff seam = S01-E − S09)
derived.label: REFERENCE ONLY — NOT A JACKETEK TARGET
derived.formula: S02-E + ½ × B09 (= Golden Bear's centre-back sleeve by construction)
derived.confidence: Reference only — centre back → cuff is never confused with shoulder point → cuff

derived.name: Body Width at Waistband Seam — Flat
derived.label: DERIVED DEVELOPMENT VALUE
derived.formula: B03 = B01 (initial straight-body shell before rib contraction)
sampleChecks: visual blouse over the waistband rib
derived.patternMakerRule: If a slight taper is technically preferable, the pattern maker must propose it explicitly — never change the value silently.

sources.si: WAIST / BODY POM location; visual only

patternMaker.what: Shoulder slope / drop at the dropped shoulder point — no source publishes it.
Armhole depth, armhole and sleeve cap — PATTERN_MAKER_SET + SAMPLE_VALIDATION. Not derived from Golden Bear or S.i.: no source gives a defensible JACKETEK dropped-shoulder value.
Shoulder length HPS → shoulder point = ½ × (B09 − C05); needs the neck width C05.
Rib heights and stripe layout — depend on the rib the factory proposes (S.i. rib heights are example values). S09 also fixes S02.
Rib openings and rib cut lengths — follow B03 / sleeve width × the rib ratio the pattern maker sets.
Waist, across front / back, bicep, elbow — measuring levels and values from the pattern.
Pocket opening, position, angle and bag.

sampleValidation.rule: Every value in this chart — development targets, derived values, SC-1 and the pattern maker's values — is measured on the physical M sample before anything is production approved.

sampleOnly.note: Back length from HPS = B06 + C07 (known once C07 is set / measured)
Underarm sleeve length — follows the armhole (SC-3)
Embroidery zone units: body = B07 − R01, sleeve = S02
